in_sanskrit.name: विजय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विजय (vijaya) - victory, conquest, triumph, rule; यस्य (yasya) - whose; इति (iti) - thus; विजयी (vijayī) - victorious, conqueror.

in_hindi.name: विक्रम
in_hindi.long_meaning: विक्रम (vikrama) - power, strength, might, conquering; इति (iti) - thus; विक्रमी (vikramī) - powerful, strong, mighty, conquering.

in_tamil.name: விக்ரமம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: விக்ரமம் (vigramam) - power, strength, might, conquering; இது (idu) - this; விக்ரமம் (vigramam) - power, strength, might, conquering.

in_telugu.name: విక్రమ
in_telugu.long_meaning: విక్రమ (vikrama) - power, strength, might, conquering; ఇథే (ithē) - here; విక్రమయ్య (vikramayy) - powerful, strong, mighty, conquering.

in_marathi.name: Vikrm
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikrm हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikrm is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vikrama' which means 'to be strong, powerful, to be free from obstacles, to be victorious'.

in_bengali.name: Vikrm
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Powerful, Strong
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vikrm একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vikrm is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vikrama' which means 'to be strong, powerful, to be free from obstacles, to be victorious'.
